verdict.rationale: smolagents is a library for building agents, and most of its evidence shows developer primitives such as CodeAgent and agent.run(). However, it does ship its own ready-to-run CLI agents (smolagent, webagent) that let users hand off a task without writing code, which counts as a built-in agent you can delegate to. That CLI is documented only in a single line, and there is no evidence of an integrated assistant experience. Missing for 10: documented built-in assistant UX, details of the smolagent/webagent delegation workflow, hands-on corroboration of the CLI agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: CLI Tools: Comes with command-line utilities (smolagent, webagent) for quickly running agents without writing boilerplate code.
